description: Batch sizes of the KernelBench level 2 problem 66 linear layer (16384 x 16384 weight) followed by the softmax over its 16384 outputs; the original five cases (64 to 1024 rows) are extended down to 8 rows for a 128x performance span. Every case streams the 1 GiB weight. Batches 1, 3, 100 and 1000 are correctness-only boundary shapes.
